input.body:
label: bug
file: none

Thanks for the detailed report. The "Malformed row" message comes from the column-count check that runs against the parsed header on row 1 (see src/i18n/en.json for the error text, though the actual check lives in the CSV parsing module, which we weren't able to pin down exactly in this pass). Since the files open fine in a spreadsheet and the only change was switching to a new Windows export tool, the most likely cause is that the new tool writes a different delimiter, a different line-ending (CRLF vs LF), or a UTF-8 BOM/extra whitespace on the header line, which throws off the column count before any data is read. We'll need to inspect a sample file from the new export tool (hex dump of the first line) to confirm which of these it is and adjust the parser to tolerate it.
